_note: Ingest robustness (PLAN.md §9 edges 14-15, §10 row (i)). Seven rows: two good, one prospect_key not in the batch, one duplicate key, one with no body, one that is not an object, one with no prospect_key. Nothing may be silently dropped — every row lands in exactly one bucket, and the good drafts carry extra unknown keys that ingest must tolerate.

drafts.subject: the compactor doesn't take messages
drafts.body:
Hey Alex,

most hardscape owners I talk to already tried an answering service for the phones and it made things worse instead of better.

you're on the compactor and the homeowner calls the next crew on the list.

how many calls do you figure slip by in a week?

Sam
